description: Expected-goal model fit on MoneyPuck unblocked shots. See tools/xg_fit.py for the method.

sources.terms: free for non-commercial use with credit to MoneyPuck.com
free for non-commercial use with credit to MoneyPuck.com

onNetShareNote: share of unblocked shots that hit the net in the 2025-26 file; the engine divides xG by this when it scores a puck that has already reached the goalie
onNetByTierNote: share of unblocked shots that hit the net in each danger tier (by this model's xG) in the 2025-26 file; the engine puts a shot on net at this rate and divides xG by it when the puck reaches the goalie

tiers.note: MoneyPuck danger tiers are defined by xG; these thresholds reproduce the league tier goal rates in moneypuck-2025.json

model.recipe: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coef[f] * x[f])))); dist in ft from net center, angle in degrees from the midline (absolute), logDist = ln(dist+1), dist2 = dist^2/100, angle2 = angle^2/100, distAngle = dist*angle/100, speed = min(ft/s from last event, 60)/10, type_* one flag (WRIST baseline), rebound/offWing/pp/sh are 0 or 1; a feature the caller cannot measure takes its value from defaults (the dataset mean). MoneyPuck's shotRush flag is not used: it is populated for almost no shots in the 2025-26 file

grid.desc: baseline xG, wrist shot at even strength with no rebound or rush; grid[x][y] with x = feet from the goal line toward center ice (0 to 89) and y = feet off the net midline (0 to 42, mirrored)
